nom: VICHY Normaderm Daily Acne Face Wash, 0.5% Salicylic Acid Cleanser

avis.titre: Good but would prefer it without fragrance
avis.texte: I bought this for a relative who has oily acne-prone skin which is also sensitive. So far they only use this once a day (at night), to prevent excess dryness, and in the morning they use the Vanicream Gentle Cleanser. Previously this relative had been using the Paula's Choice CLEAR Pore Normalizing Cleanser twice a day which also has 0.5% salicylic acid, but it had been drying out their skin. My relative appreciated the pump bottle of the Vichy, but wished it was also fragrance-free like the Paula's Choice and Vanicream cleansers. The Vichy has a slight herbal scent that they find unnecessary and slightly off-putting. It remains to be seen whether the Vichy is more drying than the Paula's Choice; my relative would have to use the Vichy twice a day in order to fully test that. I will report back when I know more.

avis.auteur: The Kat who walks by herself
avis.texte: This is a very good value, besides the fact that it works so well. I have ultra sensitive skin, and Lupus, for I easily flare into that classic Lupus “mask” on my face. This doesn’t trigger it at all, in spite of its wonderful fresh fragrance (which actually made me afraid to try it! I typically can’t do any fragrance at all on my face) It is a very light and fresh scent, and a very little bit of cleanser goes a very long way. I use an amount about the size of a ladybug in my palm, and rub my hands together to get a lather, then apply it to my wet face. Works beautifully and my face feels clean, and never tight or stripped afterward. I sent some to my daughter to try and she loves it too!

It is highly recommended for oily and acne-prone skin. Its dermatological formula deeply cleans pores, eliminates excess sebum and reduces outbreaks? My husband has used it for the last few months and the results are very satisfactory

I’ve been using this Vichy face wash for 5 years and I can’t live without it. My skin is very oily and acne-prone, and this cleanser really helps prevent breakouts and dries out existing acne quickly. It does leave my skin feeling a bit dry after use, so I always follow up with a good moisturizer. I absolutely love this product and highly recommend it for anyone with oily or acne-prone skin.
I've been using this brand cleanser for years and love it. Good lather, cleanses well, isn't drying, and keeps my skin clear. The price is reasonable for the quality of product.

I’ve been really loving this acne cleanser! It actually works without feeling heavy or harsh on my skin. It leaves my face feeling clean and fresh, and I’ve noticed a nice improvement in my skin’s texture with consistent use. It’s gentle enough for everyday use while still helping with breakouts. Definitely a great cleanser if you’re looking for something effective but lightweight!
Muy bueno el producto y la entrega el día que indicaron estoy contenta

avis.titre: Great for blemish-prone skin — clean, fresh, and effective!
avis.texte: I’ve been using the Vichy Normaderm Intensive Purifying Cleanser for a few weeks, and it has quickly become one of my favourite skincare products. My skin is blemish-prone and can get oily in the T-zone, but also sensitive — so finding something that cleans deeply without irritating is a challenge. This cleanser hits the perfect balance. The formula with salicylic acid and zinc really helps keep breakouts under control. After washing, my skin feels properly clean and purified but never stripped or tight. I’ve noticed fewer new blemishes and less shine throughout the day, which is a huge win. The texture lathers nicely, the scent is fresh and not overpowering, and the 200ml bottle lasts longer than expected since you only need a small amount. If you struggle with clogged pores or recurring breakouts, I definitely recommend giving this a try. It’s gentle, effective, and genuinely improves the look and feel of blemish-prone skin.
I’ve been using this for a while and have noticed fewer breakouts. It cleanses well, doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy, and makes my face feel fresh and clean. Highly recommend!
Este jabón cito te ayuda mucha con la grasa de tu piel ..! Y ayuda mucho a combatir el acné es especialmente para el acné
I have hormonal acne and this cleanser really helps with breakouts, it also makes my skin feel really soft.
Demasiado bueno para pieles mixtas o grasas se siente una verdadera limpieza desde su primer uso No lo cambio por nada Me llegó super rápido

avis.titre: Best face wash I've ever used!
avis.texte: I've used this face wash twice a day for 8 out of 10 days since it was delivered. It's made a huge difference in my skins appearance! My skin has always been excessively oily. I've also have struggled with acne & breakouts my whole life. This is the first face wash I have found that doesn't cause more breakouts, doesn't irritate my sensitive skin & also doesn't try my skin out like so many others have! I'll definitely be buying this again when I need a refill.

avis.titre: Really big & good value for your money
avis.texte: I’m sooo in lust 🤤 with this cleanser, first because the bottle it’s huge (400ml), it leaves my skin very velveting like, one tiny pump is enough to make a good foamy mixture to cleanse the face!
He probado muchas marcas en el mercado y siempre vuelvo a este, me encanta!

Love this product for my skin helps me so much with my acne. I LOVE THIS ! It changed everything for my skin routine, I have bought this twice and ana changed my bad acne to durable and at times looking super clear.
I was so excited to use this product, but it came like it was already used. Dirt is all over it. Absolutely not putting it on my face.
It says there's new packaging. I got the older version, there's no seal, and the top is broken. Up update review once the I get s different bottle.

avis.titre: NOT for daily use on very sensitive skin.
avis.texte: This product really does work, but be cautious if you have really sensitive skin. I have acne-prone/oily/sensitive/reactive skin for reference. I was experiencing a really bad hormonal breakout along my jawline and neck. I washed once with this cleanser and by the next morning my skin was almost completely cleared up with no new breakouts. I did an additional cleanse that next day and discovered that two days in a row with this product is just too much for my sensitive skin to handle. After the second use, my skin felt itchy and I noticed tiny whiteheads randomly starting to develop around my face (fungal acne). I should have just stopped while I was ahead. So from now on, I will just do the one cleanse and leave it at that. I’m strictly using this cleanser as needed because it is just too strong for continuous daily use on my very sensitive skin. Two days or more in a row and I’m just creating new skin problems. So if you have skin like mine, I recommend doing a one and done skincare routine with this cleanser. It really does clear acne, but can cause problems if overused.

I usually break out about a week before my period, so using this for the past week was a good test to see how effective it is. It appears to work pretty well! I'm not a huge fan of the scent, it smells medicinal, but it lathers well and rinses clean. My face kind of tingles afterwards, like a menthol/minty feeling. I've used items from this brand before, and I generally trust them. The only downside is that it was shipped in a regular poly bag (no bubble protection) and the top broke. I was able to re-attach it enough to use it, but it's a little awkward. I fault the shipper not the product, so not docking stars for that.

NORMADERM GEL CLEANSER This is a Face wash recommended for use on the face, this products is advertised for people with sensitive skin, oily skin with/or adult acne. This products comes in a plastic dark green bottle with a white cap. The product weighs 200ml ant the expiration date is on the back bottom of the bottle. The product is liquid that is clear with the texture of a gel. It has a pleasant smell (Like tea tree, it is soft and nice) How to use it? Use 1-2 pumps of the cleanser on hands and work into a lather and massage onto wet face. I would recommend this product to adults (25 and up) who have normal-sensitive skin and who are having difficulty in certain areas of their skin with breakouts. I would definitely buy it again, it complies with what was promoted. (It met my expectations) Pros: - Dermatologist-Tested - Free of parabens **, Sulfate, SLS, Oil, Alcohol, Soap - Allergy Tested - Luxurious yet affordable products Things to keep in mind: - As it is in everything, to see results you have to be constant - Light Fragrance ** Parabens: These are chemicals that are used as preservatives in many cosmetic products. It has been related to tumors such as breast or male reproductive system due to the presence of estrogens in this compound. Oil Free: Refers to cosmetic products that do not contain greasy agents, so they are usually recommended for oily skin, with excess sebum production and a tendency to acne.

I have been breaking out because of the hot weather in combined with wearing masks and sweating underneath. I love this thin gel cleanser. Just a bit will foam up very nicely. I do feel that it does get you skin clean, but is a tad bit drying, so moisturize after. I love that it comes in a pump bottle. If you have sensitive oily skin you may also like this cleaner. Overall, great quality product!

Vichy Normaderm Daily Acne Face Wash, Salicylic Acid Face. Cleansing! Effectively cleanses oily acne prone skin or combo skin! My teen likes it for her oily acne prone skin and it works for my combination skin as well! Skin feels refreshed and clean after washing. I feel it reaches my large pores and cleanses them. And It's gentle - it doesn't make my skin tight or feel stripped. The cleanser feels like dense gel. Easy to spread and lathers well. Pretty big bottle - it looks like it will last awhile. "It has a light fresh scent which is fine for me, but it does smell a bit chemically. Did not come tamper sealed but the pump was locked down. Made in France. Thorough cleanser for my combo skin and my teen's oily skin!

Let me start with how fabulous it smells, considering it helps with acne I certainly love love love smell of it! Now it’s absolutely gentle on my skin, cleaned really well and it felt super soft and smooth after just first use. In my opinion top notch cleanser and helped with my very oily skin. I use it at night and my skin felt fresh and clean right away. I used Vichy since I was a teenager and I love the quality of their skin care, including this cleanser, just outstanding!

I’ve always been tempted to try Vichy products because they appear to be a more high-end skincare option. I have adult acne and have struggled with problem skin since my early teens. The first thing I did was smell this cleanser.... and it has a wonderfully clean, fresh scent (unisex but slightly floral; hints of rose, tea tree oil and perhaps cucumber). Having 0.5% salicylic acid is a great amount for daily use because it doesn’t overly dry out your skin, and causes less irritation and burning sensation. My skin feels super clean, fresh and hydrated after using this cleanser. My skin appears to be clearing up fast, too!! While some may find $18 a bit expensive for a facial wash, you won’t be disappointed! In my opinion it made my skin feel as soft and purified as one of my $50 products!!

avis.titre: Very Nice Cleansing Gel, Doesn’t Sting
avis.texte: This cleansing gel has a subtle, but pleasant scent. Applies easily and washes off without making my face feel tight. Since I have sensitive skin, I was pleased that this product didn’t sting my skin.
Big size bottle! Smell isn’t strong works great! I would definitely buy again.

avis.titre: Perfect for Adult Dry Acne Prone Skin
avis.texte: This face wash works wonders on my dry acne prone skin. As an adult it’s hard to find a product for acne (specifically cystic) that is ok to use on dry skin. Vichy did an amazing job with this face wash! The texture is a nice gel that lathers up so you feel it cleaning your skin. It rinses off incredibly well! It doesn’t make my skin tight and within a day my acne and redness has gone down or completely away! I rate this product an A!

This product works well to clear and prevent acne. It definitely cleans the skin well and has acne medicine in it. It smells kind of like medicine…. Not a bad scent, but not amazing either. It’s made in France. It is definitely worth a try. I like it.

My boyfriend and I have been using this face wash for about three days now. So far neither of us have had any negative reactions to it. In fact, I think it works great. My boyfriend has very sensitive skin and almost everything makes him break out, this has not caused any issues for him. My skin seems to like it as well. I will update again if anything changes. I hope you find this helpful!

My skin feels very clean with this wash and not excessively tight or drying. Rinses clean with no residue. It smells medicinal, but the scent is completely gone after rinsing. Very happy with this face wash. Foams up easily.

avis.titre: It’s not the same as the original Normaderm
avis.texte: The new “phytoaction” cleaner came to replace the original one that I used per 15+years. The thickness is the same but the fragance and the effectiveness changed. I got blemishes and my skin is more oily than it used to be when using the original version. My skin used to feel so smooth after using the original product, but not anymore. Moreover, I try to post a similar review to this one in their website, and they did not publish it, so be aware of their reviews!

avis.titre: Was probably the best facial cleanser I’ve ever used. Now they’ve changed the formula
avis.texte: UPDATE: I ordered the pump, and the formula has changed. No longer reads PHYTOACTION, and the inactive ingredients have changed, with additions like glycerin and citric acid as well as omitting the copper minerals. Yet they are still advertising the old formula. I am returning. OLD REVIEW: I love this product. Finally a facial cleanser that eliminates breakouts yet is gentle on my skin. I subscribe every other month; 4 stars because the last two that have been sent have not been packaged well by the sender and have been damaged. The last one was too bad to keep.

avis.titre: Not the same product as before
avis.texte: I feel like others should know that this product has changed. I bought this last year and I’m just now finishing it up. It last a long time and it’s my favorite cleanser. I went to order it again and when I went to replace my bottle I noticed a couple of differences. Flipped over to compare the inactive ingredients and wow!! There is a definite difference. So if you haven’t purchased this product in a while, just know that it has changed. And if your skin is like mine, it doesn’t react well to these changes.

I don't know if I got counterfeit or the formula changed. After using my last purchase, I just don't feel the same results as before, and it's so frustrating because I USED TO LOVE and recommend this product to everyone. I compared with an old bottle and ingredients changed. My skin is less smooth, not as soft as before. I don't like the change.
Ordene un producto page por el y me llega defectuoso, creo que deben de ser mas cuidadosos al momento de empacar y enviar sus productos
I like this face wash. However I received a damaged bottle. This did not happen in transit as there were no broken pieces in the sealed package.
The product is really good but the bottle material is really cheap.

avis.titre: Helps control acne for oily skin
avis.texte: I’ve been using this Vichy Normaderm several times a week. The pump is short which prevents too much from coming out. It’s perfect for me because I only use this on my forehead, sides of my face and chin. It seems to shrink my small acne bumps. The smell is not too strong and lathers up lightly. I recommend giving this a try.
